records.public_safe_text: on february 06, 2018 at approximately 1540 hours, unit 1 driver advised she was in the [roadway] stopped in the z1-b parking lot entrance/exit facing eastbound. a pedestrain was standing on the sidewalk located in the [roadway] by z1-b entrance/exit. the driver of unit 1 stated she was waiting on a truck that was stopped in the parking lot (z1-a) across from where she was stopped, but there was truck stopped on the side by the east entrance/exit dropping off a passenger. unit 1 driver advised the truck made a right turn going northbound and she proceeded to turn left when the pedestrain took off at the same time she took off, striking the pedestrain. upon arrival, i observed the pedestrain laying on the ground on her right side of her body. she was conscious and shaking. i asked her what part of her body was injured and she stated her right ankle and lower back. unit 1 was upset and crying. unit 1 showed me her vehicle, a 2006 toyota avalon, maroon in color that she moved to the z1-a parking lot, after striking the pedestrain. i took 3 digital photographs of the front side of the vehicle and did not observe any dents on the hood. the vehicle had dirt on the hood and could clearly see where zapata's hands were imprinted on the hood of unit 1's vehicle. see attached photographs. i placed the 3 digital photographs into the texas tech police department evidence drop box as evidence. the parking services entry station #7 is located in the [roadway] and it has a surveillance camera. i spoke to the entry station employee (erik hanson), who witnessed the accident. he stated he observed unit 1 make a left turn at a fast pace, striking the pedestrain [roadway] located in the [roadway]. hanson advised he ran over there and the pedestrain was injured, while the driver of unit 1 was calling 911. i was able to obtain the video footage of the accident from transportation & parking services (herb wright). i placed the video footage into the texas tech police department evidence drop box as evidence. after viewing the video footage, it clearly shows the pedestrain walking across facing eastbound in the [roadway] first, almost crossing the yellow line. i observe a dark blue truck traveling northbound as she is still walking across, when unit 1 is making a left turn, striking the right side of zapata's body. there were two witnesses: erik hanson [phone] or [phone] matthew carroll 512-7051755emergency medical services (ems) arrived at 1547 [medical facility] for further evaluation.
